tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite source for educational YouTube videos. Create TWO tall full-body poses side by side in a clean1-row2-column layout, each exactly half the canvas width. Highest native resolution available, transparent RGBA background. Input image1 is the EXACT adopted identity/style reference, not a pixel-edit target. Redraw fresh. The exact adopted Hawksbill Turtle shown in image1; identity features: 褐色の重なった甲板・斑入り頭肢・小さい鉤状嘴. Remain a simplified bird-like/water-animal PROP, never a humanoid. Preserve precisely the existing anatomical body, wings/fins/flippers/feet/tail that are visible; no human arms, hands, legs, teeth, clothing or anime eyes. Use broad clean colour blocks, no detailed feather barbs or naturalistic diagram. Preserve its exact eye format when open (white surrounds only if the reference has them, same pupil and no added highlights), facial markings, palette, warm brown contours and subtle paper/watercolor texture. No realistic animal proportions or heavy outline change. All poses keep SAME anatomical head/body scale and proportions as the adopted reference, including every resting/blink/crouch state. Lots of true transparent padding around each complete subject and between cells; no cropped horns/gills/bill/tail/feet. No text, labels, grid lines, backgrounds, ground/shadow, props, sparkles, extra animals or duplicate/disconnected limbs. Required reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1 PRESENT_LEFT: Direct the bill/head/gaze and an existing wing/flipper if suitable toward VIEWER LEFT; keep real existing anatomy. 2 PRESENT_RIGHT: Naturally turn the head/body to indicate VIEWER RIGHT using only the existing bill/head/wing/flipper. Not a simple flip-copy; preserve asymmetrical markings/anatomy. Species constraint: 隠れていた肢を無理に足さず、前後フリッパーを重複させない。タイマイの甲板とオサガメの筋・白斑を混同しない。 Clean bounded color areas and connected silhouettes; no pigment spills, background haze or extra marks. Do not insert an additional neutral; it is reused from image1.
CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY: true RGBA isolated sprites only. Every pixel outside the separated character silhouettes must have alpha 0, including all gutters and all four canvas corners. Do not paint a beige/white/grey paper rectangle, backdrop, floor, contact shadow, border, diffuse halo, ambient shadow, red/yellow low-alpha colour field or speckles. Watercolour texture must be clipped to the characters themselves. Fresh original drawing, no postprocessing.

original_output.availability: Historical tool location; bundled saved_output is the usable original.

record_scope: Selected source only. Historical candidate/QA files are source-workspace history, not bundled dependencies.
